notes.title: Shield My Hubris
notes.content:
Attention Architect!

Patch 244 released.
Build `20241227`

I have been busy with Annihilate The Spance, my team's big project. But I have squeezed my freetime out to bring you this update with a large number of changes. Shield Nerfs and adjustments, bug fixes, UI improvements and feature work. Alongside a wonderful update to the core engine's performance and rendering.

Shields
- All shields are now modular, and can be attached to hardpoints.
- Shields have some nice unique visuals.
- Significantly increased the cost of all shields. ( x5 )
- Set all shields to a reactivation threshold of 50%
- Set all shields to an energy-for-regen cost of 2:1
- Soft Shields now have a 30% minimum size to reduce some of their more powerful behaviours.
- Shield heat regen has been reduced from 25% to 20% 

Point Defense
- Added overkill prevention to PD. It's a bit finnickey at times, but it works well enough. Let me know.
- Alkana PD is now burst fire.
- Rook PD has more sustained fire.

Reactors
- Reactors have been replaced with 4 scales of module reactor that can be attached to hardpoints.

Thrusters
- Increased the thrust power (and price) of most all higher tier thrusters to give way more UMPH.

UI / Workbench
- The Block Palette has been overhauled to offer a clear view of the blocks and fit more on screen.
- When selecting a block from the palette, it will now "stay" in your hand while you build. You can clear your hand with Right Click.
- If you have nothing in your hand, you now have a right click block picker. No need to hold ALT, or go back to the palette to keep building. More convenient.
- Various UI fixes and adjustments.
- Various fixes and adjustments, including a fix to undo for individual blocks.

- I've been working on this in my off time for about 4 months, I've probably forgotten something.

notes.title: SHOCK AND AWESOME
notes.content:
Attention Architect!

The Shock family of weapons are with us. A trio of armaments dedicated to the decimation of shields, and the destruction of stacked shielding. Bring woe and terror upon those that stack their equipment with wonton abandon!

[b]Shock[/b] is the only area-of-effect damage type in VA, and performs two roles:
- Retards the performance of blocks hit. Slowing fire rates, reducing thruster power, and disabling functions.
- Super heats shields, dealing 3x it's value in heat to shielding. Often maxing out a shield's heat capacity and turning it into a fragile dome of shattering energy.
- Deals no damage. Shock may be utterly powerful against shields, but it is next to useless against raw steel hull.

= = =

Patch 238 released
Build `Win_VectoredArmada_20240907_1403`

- Added the Shock weapon family, Ohm, Silencer and Havoc.
- Added SHOCK damage type, which hits everything in a wide area, retarding weapons and utilities, and dealing strong damage to shields.
- Gladiator Drone now uses a Shock missile - the only shock missile in the game.
- Shields now have an overhauled visual that responds to the current heat level of the shield ( aka, it's regen rate )
- Adjusted drone and ship movement with a new system that should better try to handle acceleration and deceleration as well as matching the velocity of the target.
- Adjusted avoidance behavior to handle edge cases a bit better.
- Lots of other misc fixes and changes.

notes.title: Heating Hardpoints
notes.content:
Attention Architects. Major update has been released. Please let me know if you find any bugs or errors.

Patch 206-215 released
Build `Win_VectoredArmada_20240619_1852`

Summary:
- Added Hardpoint weapons. Which can be attached to orange mounts on almost any block of a similar or larger size.
- Added Hardpoint Mounts to most blocks.
- Shields now take Heat damage from weapons. Heat builds up while under fire and reduces shield regeneration, but cools off reasonably quickly.
- Replaced the ship movement system with a different calculation that should perform more gracefully.
- A large number of fixes and block adjustments.

[b]Shield Heat Explanation:[/b]
Shields have been a hard thing to balance. I want them to be both strong and useful, but not invulnerable against weapons. Shield Heat, allows shields to be quite powerful, but become less and less useful while under fire. Hopefully, this will make shields less omnipotent. However, this handicap for shields may need to be increased in the future as needed to make shields a proper component of combat. I played around with a range of values, and have settled on something that should feel decent.

Hardpoints:
A big issue with games like this, is wanting to make a ship out of different pieces but being limited by what shapes the weapons are built into by the developer. So after some fighting and brain work, I've gotten a hardpoint system working that allows you to put any weapon on any block. Should be fun!

notes.title: 0.83 - Surf The Shockwave
notes.content:
VA is 14 days old. Welcome to 0.83

The updates to far have made quite a big improvement to VA overall. So with these improvements, additions and fixes I think it's time to up the version number.

= = =

Patch 190-192 released.
Build 20240414

- Added fancy explosions to Controls blowing up. Including a nice shockwave, and bright core flash.
- Added far reaching explosion sounds when Controls blow up, so you can hear the state of the battlefield.
- Significantly improved ship behavior when trying to avoid being surrounded, but also wanting to attack something. They now properly take an equidistant standoff position from both the target position, and threat average. Though it may not be perfectly reasonable all the time, it's much better.
- Ships are now aware of the Battle Arena Boundary, and will try to fly around the circle instead of bouncing into it. Overall, this helps Missile and Drone kiters when running away. Though they can still be a bit dumb at times.
- Ship slowdown behavior has been improved somewhat, so ships should be better at not overshooting where they want to go while still being able to chase things. Though this does still need refinement.
- Reckless AIs are now way more reckless. They don't worry about getting surrounded. But also a little less reckless, they aren't as cowboy about overshooting where they want to go.
- Removed the accidental battery capacity on Decouplers. Making them cheaper.

= = =

notes.title: Beta 0.82 - Preflight Checks
notes.content:
Been doing a lot of work this week, and it feels ready.

Sure, don't have everything working that I wanted, don't have everything running as fast as I wanted. But. This is how it is. Good progress, good QOL, HUD, and ship behavior improvements. With hope, the first players to touch this - outside the many testers of course - will enjoy VA.

Latest changes:

- A general text pass across the entire game, with help from Aleks and Brendan.
- Ship thruster and movement control has been overhauled to improve their quality of traversal, intelligence of thruster use, and maneuverability.
- Ships will now try to avoid being surrounded, or otherwise outnumbered by hostiles. Aka they run away from lots of enemies.
- The Constructor Config menu can now set the Attack Distance, and Aggression of ships.
- Lasers had their prices increased sharply to keep their place as reliable PD, not mainline anti-ship weapons.
- Hard shields had their regen dropped slightly, soft shields had their capacity increased slightly. This is just a feel thing.
- Increased the block budget across the Campaign. Enemy fleets are a bit larger as well.
- Setup all the game achievements, and associated images.
- Added Help menus to most screens in the game.
- The Workbench Help menu has a lot of information on game mechanics and ship behavior. Though, probably not enough.
- A lot of scene work, fiddling, and stuff I've forgotten.
- Drone guns recoil in the correct direction. Hah.
- Anything else I did and forgot because I didn't write it down.

notes.title: Beta 0.81 - QOL, Drones, and Ekudon Cannons
notes.content:
Hey, the first VA update letter published to Steam.

For those of you seeing this after purchasing the game once it was released - first off thank you - second, WHEW, am I working day and night to get this thing ready. I am extremely stressed, and barely rest haha! There's a lot of stuff that MUST be better, and I am losing my sanity fighting to make it the case. There are some lost battles like performance with ship cluster physics body recalculations which can be done later, but on the whole things are looking really good.

( This has all been over the last few days )


Latest changes:

- Added SFX to all weapon firing, and messed with the visuals for explosions.

- All Campaign battles have been given their own hand-crafted background scene.
- The Workbench and Composer share a nice relaxing scene.
- Fleet Fight has it's own colour vs colour scene.

- Added a number of simple "save a ship with x stats" achievements for fun.

- Drones have had their behavioral, and weapon values fixed and adjusted. They now correctly standoff against targets at roughly their weapon range. The Goshawk's beam now actually works, and the Gladiator missile launcher is slightly stronger.

- The Laser family have had their PD abilities vastly improved, and are now 100% reliable, while still costing a decent portion of Energy investment to keep running.

- Overall weapon targeting has been improved in terms of ship vs drone vs missile preferances.

- Ship slowdown on approach has been fixed(?), ships should now more reliably attempt to retreat to maintain their preferred standoff based on their average weapon ranges weighted by DPS. ( PD weapons barely contribute to this value, but are present for the sake of situations where ships are left with only their PD weapons. )

- The Ekudon Cannon has had it's damage quadroupled 1000 > 4000, and had it's energy cost halved from 2x to 1x. It still takes 4000 energy to fire but is reasonably accessible without vast infrastructure.

- The Workbench has had it's top bar restored, for quick access to the rest of the game such as the Composer. This was off due to technical complexity at the time, but those issues have been solved. ( Look there's a lot of game state to mannage and it was a bit overwhelming at the time so I turned it off. )

- The Campaign has been added as an item on the Quick Access hotbar.

- Settings can now be accessed from anywhere in the game, generally found at the top of the screen near the Quick Access hotbar.

- Battle Budgets can now be pinned, and those limits will be shown in the Composer as you build a fleet. Not yet present in the Workbench, I need to find a place for it to fit.

- Fixed some broken buttons caused by accidental prefab edit cause-and-effect. My bad.

- Misc bug fixes and probably plenty stuff that's important but that I have forgotten about due to not writing it down as I did it.

Enjoy.
- Luke AP
